Divã Psicanalítico

A study tool. Use classic cases, fictional vignettes or fully anonymised material: health data is sensitive. The readings and debates are teaching reconstructions of each author's ideas, not quotations, and they do not replace personal analysis, supervision or reading the original texts. In supervised practice, the official record is the clinic's or service's case file; only anonymised study notes are kept here. Check with your supervisor and your institution whether they are allowed. In a risk situation, contact your supervisor and the care network; in a crisis, call your local emergency line.
